title: 从偶维中间上同调的近似 Frobenius 权重推出各次数的精确权重（Milne 28.3）
public_hold_reason: Public redistribution of edited independent excerpts is not established.
author_responsibility: 保留 Milne 原讲义的题面、主证明和引用先修。收录判断对应完整的条件归约。
material_provenance: 原官方 202 页 LEC v2.21 固定 PDF，按物理页和原索引区间直接引用。
difficulty_reason: The first half creates exact middle-degree weights from a bounded exponent error: place α^m into the middle degree of the m-fold product using the Frobenius-equivariant Künneth map, use all even m, and take mth roots. The second half combines complementary-degree reciprocity with a finite-field extension to obtain a smooth hyperplane, uses vanishing on its affine complement to force Gysin surjectivity, and transfers the lower-dimensional weights with the q scaling. This coordination is the actual new argument, above a direct invocation of a cohomology theorem.

statement_spans.label: 完整原 Proposition 28.3。保留偶维中间上同调、代数性、所有复共轭以及原双侧严格近似界。

proof_spans.label: 主证明第一段。Frobenius 相容 Künneth 乘积、取偶次幂及开方极限，得到任意维数中间次数的精确权重。
主证明第二段。对偶降到 r>d，经 28.1 扩域选取光滑超平面截面，用仿射消失、Gysin 满射及 Frobenius 的 q 因子完成维数归纳。终止于第 162 页原证明方框。

standard_prerequisites: 光滑适当且 ℓ≠p 的 Qℓ Künneth 公式和 Poincaré 对偶。
Bertini、仿射上同调维数界、光滑对的 Gysin 序列及 Frobenius 相容性。

target_scope.original_statement: Under the approximate two-sided bounds q^(d/2−1/2)<|α′|<q^(d/2+1/2) for every complex conjugate of each algebraic Frobenius eigenvalue on even-dimensional middle cohomology in the original finite-field setting, derive the all-degrees exact weight assertion of 27.15. Preserve the original non-singular projective and Chapter II absolute irreducibility/ℓ≠p scope.
target_scope.finite_field_scope: 沿用 Chapter II 的任意有限域设置与原 28.1。作者在 Bertini 步显式使用有限扩域。归约没有断言仅凭一个预先固定有限域上的近似结论即可完成整段证明。
target_scope.conditional_conclusion: 只选择 28.3 的条件归约，近似界为原题假设。27.15 的完整 Deligne 证明另有待补。
target_scope.adjacent_footnote: A separately attributed A. Mellit alternate approach on p162 [434863,435330) is contextual and outside the selected main proof. PDF crop confirms the alternate passage prints H^(rd)(X^(rd)), while the displayed count of factors is r. Record the mismatch without correcting the author or using the footnote as proof.
